text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that does not involve any LULC future prediction. The study analyzes historical land cover changes (2000–2015) and human impacts on ecosystems within China’s national nature reserves using observed remote sensing data (e.g., DMSP/OLS nighttime lights, NDVI-derived VFC, GLO-PEM-simulated NPP). It does not implement or compare future LULC scenarios, lacks predictive modeling, and focuses on assessing past ecosystem dynamics rather than projecting future land use/cover. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of having a primary focus on LULC prediction with future scenarios.)
